text:
alex: Hey team — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/1534 is ready but I'm pausing merge. This touches routing + canary fallback logic and we need an architecture sign-off tied to RFC-482: <https://rfc.redwood.ai/rfc/482|RFC-482>. Can an architect take a look? cc @sam @chris

maria: Acked. Is the change backwards compatible for current Dedicated config? Any runtime flag needed? :eyes: 

alex: Good q. Backwards compatible by default; you can opt into the new routing via a service config flag. I added a short note in the PR description. There's a tiny behavior change for overloaded shards when fallback kicks in — it's covered in RFC-482 section 3.4.

sam (arch): I can review today. Quick ask: can you paste the canary rollout snippet and the KV cache gating logic here? makes it faster to review.

alex: Sure — excerpt from the config in the PR:
```
rollout:
  mode: canary
  traffic: 5%
fallback:
  enabled: true
  policy: "region-prefer"
```
and the kv-cache gating is a 2-line check in router:
```
if request.prefix in kv_cache: use_cache()
else: continue_normal
```

ci-bot: CI passed — unit tests 123/123, integration staging ok :white_check_mark:

chris (pm): I reviewed RFC-482 last week. Important note: section 3.4 requires adding metrics for "fallback_reason" and tagging by route_id. Can we ensure metrics are emitted in this PR? Otherwise we'll lose signal on regressions.

alex: Good catch. I missed that metric. I'll add a small metrics emit of fallback_reason and route_id before the fallback call.

megan: Also, can we keep the canary window to 24h and ensure automatic rollback if error-rate > 2%? Ops prefers that as a default.

alex: I wired a canary duration param in the rollout config; will default to 24h. I'll also add a simple automatic rollback predicate (error_rate > 0.02).

sam (arch): Thanks. After the metrics + rollback predicate change I can give LGTM. Please link the updated RFC section in the PR and tag me when ready.

alex: Will do — pushing the changes now. ETA ~30m.

alex: pushed changes and updated PR description with RFC anchor: <https://rfc.redwood.ai/rfc/482#section-3-4|RFC-482 §3.4>. PTAL @sam @chris

sam (arch): Reviewing now. small nit: prefer fallback metric name fallback_trigger over fallback_reason. Can you rename? Then I'll LGTM.

alex: Done, renamed metric and bumped changelog. Thanks!

sam (arch): LGTM from architecture side. :heavy_check_mark:

chris (pm): LGTM from PM assuming metrics land (seen) and canary defaults ok.

megan: Ops ok with 24h + rollback preset.

alex: Awesome — thanks everyone. I'll merge once CI is green and no other blocking comments. Leaving merge hold tag until midnight PST for extra eyeballs.

ci-bot: Nightly checks passed at 1735557000 :white_check_mark:

alex: Merged. Rolling out canary 5% -> monitoring.

megan: Watching metrics. Ping if anything spikes.

sam (arch): Thanks all. Thread resolved for the architecture blocker.
